Subject: Demo request — Search & Recommendations (ShopFlux)

Hi Vivek,

We just signed up a few teammates and I wanted to see if we could get a short walkthrough of Redwood focused on search & recommendations. Primary goals: faster reranks for product search, embeddings for similarity, and a low-latency A/B pilot in Q4.

Quick context:
- Company: ShopFlux (marketplace, ~12M monthly queries)
- Use case: product search + personalized recs in checkout flow
- Current infra: internal ES + Redis; looking to offload model inference to a hosted endpoint
- Timeline: pilot kickoff in mid-November, production in Q1

Can your team cover typical throughput, latency SLOs, and cost per 10k tokens for a median query length (~40 tokens)? Also curious if you support embeddings-only endpoints for batched vectorization.

Would appreciate a 30m slot next week if available — timezone is ET.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Head of Search, ShopFlux

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and welcome to Redwood. Quick answers up front: we support embeddings-only endpoints, dedicated low-latency routing for real-time recs, and we can share per-10k-token pricing ranges depending on config (batching / quantization).

Before we lock a demo, a couple quick qualification questions so we make the session productive:

1) Expected QPS profile for the pilot: average queries per second and peak? (ballpark is fine — e.g., 20 avg / 200 peak)
2) Typical tokens per query (you said ~40) — do you include user history / context in that token count?
3) Pilot duration & success criteria: 6 weeks ramp with 10% traffic vs full cutover in Q1?
4) Any security constraints: SSO, IP allowlists, SOC2 evidence required?
5) Technical contact to join the call (for infra/SSO questions) and their timezone.

Proposed 30m slots (ET):
- Tue 2026-10-20 11:00–11:30 ET
- Wed 2026-10-21 15:00–15:30 ET
- Thu 2026-10-22 09:30–10:00 ET

I attached a short one-pager (redwood-onepager.pdf) that covers latency profiles and typical throughput buckets — Ben (copied) will join the call to run through a sample throughput matrix. If those slots don't work, tell us a 48-hour window that fits and we can propose alternatives.

Short answers to your specific asks:
- Throughput/latency: depends on model variant + quantization; typical hosted median latency for vector encode + 256-dim embedding is ~35–70ms, gen requests vary by model context length.
- Cost: I’ll share an estimated cost matrix once you confirm average/peak QPS and batch sizes.
- Embeddings-only: yes — separate endpoint optimized for batch vectorization.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Vivek — thanks, Ben — great detail. Answers below inline.

1) QPS: pilot target ~15 avg QPS, expected peak ~120 QPS during peak shopping hours. We’ll likely batch transforms for nightly reindexing but need real-time scoring for search.
2) Tokens: current average is 38 tokens per query; when we include 2–3 product context fields + user id history it goes to ~85 tokens for the model input. We can split embedding-only paths vs gen-based reranks.
3) Pilot: aiming for 4–6 week pilot starting Nov 15, success is <100ms 95th pct for search rank calls and improvement in top-5 CTR by 10%.
4) Security: SOC2 is required; SSO (SAML) integration preferred but not blocking for pilot.
5) Technical contact: Alicia Park (cc’d) — she’s on PT and available afternoons ET.

We need to move the demo 1 week later than your proposed dates — our internal calendar is locked next week. Can we aim for the week of Oct 26–30? Preferred windows: afternoons ET (13:00–17:00).

I’ve attached a small intake spreadsheet with our rough traffic buckets (shopflux-intake-matrix.xlsx).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Mills
